frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original flattened near-tetrapod fish fossil with preserved digit-bearing fin anatomy, MHNM06-2067-informed study. A volumetric low-poly fossil relief with genuine discrete fin elements, not a photograph/painted plane and not a free-standing living animal.

scale.status: Published specimen total length, Nature2020 abstract. Fig1a scale1m; fin Figs2–3 scales5cm.
scale.uncertainty: Slab geometry and relief depth are artist-controlled support dimensions, not measured original slab thickness. Preserve body/fin scale relationship.

frozen_scientific_scope.reveal_policy: Analytical visualization: pectoral fins are naturally visible ventrally (Fig1 caption), and the endoskeleton was CT-revealed (Fig3). This model deliberately reveals one pectoral interior in its in-situ location for study; disclose this is a virtual cutaway and not naturally exposed dorsal fossil preservation. Preserve whole specimen and in-situ scale, no oversized detached hand prop.
uncertainties: Original fossil is compressed; low-poly relief height and soft connecting silhouette are representational.
Fig3e attempts restoration of compressed element shapes; prefer Fig3d actual CT configuration rather than silently claiming restored bones are exact.
Fine scale/ray counts simplified; no scientific claim of pixel-accurate CT segmentation.
